question: What kind of will arises everywhere from scattering and equipoise?
premises: There is scattering of all consciousness
There is also equality or equipoise
inference: From dispersed awareness held in equipoise arises a pervasive will of this kind
uncertainties: Tension between kṣepa and sāmya as simultaneous causes
plain_english: From the scattering of all consciousness and from equality, such a will arises everywhere.
